business_summary: Beijing Bewinner Communications Co., Ltd. operates as a mobile internet service integrator in China. The company offers mobile games, IoT applications, and other mobile communication services. It also engages in the mobile internet industrial park operations. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
